```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(DescTools)

df <- read_excel("~/Documents/Experiments/10.30.26 scarlet.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Percent")
df1 <- read_excel("~/Documents/Experiments/10.30.26 scarlet.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Norm")

```

```{r Norm}

dfl <- df %>%  pivot_longer(
  cols = c(mCherry,mScarlet,SC,SCB),
  names_to = "Read",
  values_to = "Values")

my_comparisons <- list( c("mCherry", "mScarlet"), c("SC", "SCB"),c("mScarlet", "SCB"))
#colors <- c("mCherry" = "red","iLUX" = "cyan", "Fluor baseline"= "maroon", "Lum baseline"="blue")
  
  p <- ggplot(dfl, aes(x = Read, y=Values)) +
geom_bar(stat="summary", 
           fun=mean,
           aes(fill=Values)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), color = "black")+
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons)+
  #geom_signif(comparisons = my_comparisons, map_signif_level=TRUE)+
  labs(title="Fold above baseline",
        x ="Wavelength", y = "Fold above baseline", color = "Legend")
    #scale_color_manual(values = colors)
p

#ggsave("Scarletfold.png")

    
    
```
